#### `max_length` {#max_length}

<p class="fl-facts">optional · integer · absent: 16 · range [4, 16]</p>

**How far the trench walks in total, split between its two sides.**

Each side takes half of it in steps of one block. A column is only recorded where a surface is found.

#### `max_width` {#max_width}

<p class="fl-facts">optional · integer · absent: 4 · range [2, 8]</p>

**The width of the trench at the origin.**

It tapers to 40% of this at the far ends of the walk, on both sides.

#### `min_footprint` {#min_footprint}

<p class="fl-facts">optional · integer · absent: 10 · range [1, 32]</p>

**The fewest connected columns the trench may have.**

With fewer, the feature fails and writes nothing, though its random draws are already spent.

#### `twistiness` {#twistiness}

<p class="fl-facts">optional · number · absent: 4.0 · range [0, 16]</p>

**How much the walk bends.**

At 0 the trench runs straight, and the same random draws are taken as at any other value.

#### `carve_depth` {#carve_depth}

<p class="fl-facts">optional · range · range [4, 32]</p>

**How deep the trench is at the origin, drawn once per placement.**

It gets shallower toward the ends, and a column also ends at the first block it cannot carve.

#### `fill_depth` {#fill_depth}

<p class="fl-facts">optional · range · range [0, 32]</p>

**How far below the origin the fill starts.**

It starts at least one block below the lowest surface. It does nothing without fill_block.

#### `surface_block` {#surface_block}

<p class="fl-facts">optional · block</p>

**Written on top of each carved column.**

minecraft:air counts as none. A column that stopped at its top cell because of liquid gets none.

#### `fill_block` {#fill_block}

<p class="fl-facts">optional · block</p>

**Written instead of air at and below the fill level.**

minecraft:air counts as none. Soft neighbours are sealed first, so the fill does not leak out.
